patthana16.76:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na upādinno ca na anidassanasappaṭigho na upādinno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
